item.tib: dag snang ye shes gter mdzod bon sde las sku gsum zhing sgrub khams gsum yongs grol gyi sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes kyi bya ba yi sgrub pa bco brgyad bde chen rang grol bzhugs
item.coloph: sku gsum zhing sgrub sbyor dngos rjes kyi don shar ngor brag steng khyung rngab pho brang du rang gi sgyu lus nad kyis cung zad thebs dus/ bla ma la gsol ba btab cing thugs yid bsres pa'i mnyam bzhag rig snang ma 'gags pa dag pa'i snang ngor zhing khams mjal snang kyi (gi) sku gsum ston pas dbang bskur bka'i gtad rgya gdams pas (pa'i) don/ lung zin bstan pa'i skyes bu du ma dang / bstan bdag sa yi tshangs pa brag steng dgung rgyal (rgod ?)chen nyi ma dbang ldan rang gi kha byang lung mthun gyur pa'i bka' yis bskul ma dang / phyis su rang gnas slebs nas lo lnga'i bka' rgya yol te theg mchog brgyud 'dzin skyes (bu) rnams kyis bskul ma rten 'brel mtshams sbyar bas/ theg mchog bstan rgyas sku gsum gling khrod nas bya btang sprul ming tshe dbang 'gyur med byang chub rig rtsal gling pas nges gsang mdzod kyi khrid dang nyams len thun mtshams su chu sbrul zla tshes nyin gtan la phebs pas dge legs dpal gyi nyi ma srid mtha'i bar nub med dar bar gyur cig/
